metadata_findings: MetadataAssociation PARENT → TL1BN version 5 does not resolve (versions in CMR: ['6']); it is another version of the same ShortName, typed PARENT.
The linked ATBD index (TES_ATBDs.pdf) points to the L1B and L2 ATBDs, which return ['404'].
No association to the collections it is made from or feeds (L1B → L2 → Lite / L3).
